result.question: Before we run any trend model on Transformer 1 at MAIN, check how complete the acetylene and co records are between 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 and 2024-01-19T00:00:00.000000. For each gas, report the non-null count, the first and last timestamps with data, and any day in the window with no sample. Give each channel a verdict of 'usable' only if it has at least 4 non-null samples. If a channel fails, check whether hydrogen has at least 4 samples in the same window and could be used instead.
result.answer:
Both acetylene and co are complete for this window, so either can go into a trend model on Transformer 1 at MAIN. The window runs from 2024-01-15T00:00:00 up to but not including 2024-01-19T00:00:00, so it covers four days (Jan 15–18).

| Gas | Non-null samples | First with data | Last with data | Days with no sample | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| acetylene | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00.000000 | None | usable |
| co | 4 | 2024-01-15T00:00:00.000000 | 2024-01-18T00:00:00.000000 | None | usable |

There is one reading per day at midnight. Neither gas failed, so I didn't need hydrogen as a backup. For reference, it also has 4 samples at the same timestamps.
